entry.title: sift: Hacker News threads, scored by code
entry.summary: Hacker News discussions picked by a scoring script with no editor: up to 12 threads, several runs a day, one per domain. No account, no archive.

entry.title: nivomoney: A neobank, opened up to be read
entry.summary: A neobank, opened up to be read. Nine Go services, a double-entry ledger and React on the front, with the whole system on show.

entry.title: ledgerq: A message queue in a directory
entry.summary: An embedded Go message queue: a persistent, disk-backed log in a directory. No broker, one process, one read position, zero dependencies.
